class.name: AerialPerspectiveEffect
class.brief_description: The air between the camera and the scene.
class.description: Far hills paler and bluer, a city's far end lost in haze, a low sun's air golden: the same air as an [AtmosphereSkyMaterial]'s, laid over the scene by each pixel's distance, so the scene and the sky meet at the horizon. Use it in place of the [Environment]'s fog. Without an [AtmosphereSkyMaterial] in use, it draws nothing. Add it to a [Compositor]'s [member Compositor.compositor_effects], on a [WorldEnvironment] or [Camera3D]. It's drawn after the scene's see-through objects, before tonemapping, with the Forward+ renderer; with the others it draws nothing.

members.member: How far out the air is worked out, in meters: past the camera's far plane. Beyond it, the air is as at its end.
